svg.title: How IBM i and mainframe modernization works
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. IBM i: the database, middleware, security, runtime and hypervisor, integrated and licensed as one. IBM Bob: the Premium Package for i reads and writes source, compiles programs and runs SQL. watsonx Code Assistant for Z: maps mainframe applications, explains code and converts COBOL to Java with unit tests.
